I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines: proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356 per-seat figure and says Anselm cleared sharing it. It hasn't been sent; it sends only when someone sends it.

No approval request was needed. Per-seat rates normally go only to the CFO, the deal desk and the account owner, but Anselm is the CFO and can approve sharing them. His message counts as that approval, and Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com.

I used the figure as Anselm gave it and didn't check it against the Quarrendon account files. I replied to Anselm in the DM to say all this.
